imperfect_detection.support_overlap: true-positive count support contains 0; true-negative support contains 0

false_positive_allowed.support_overlap: true-negative count support includes the fully positive count; true-positive support includes it

interpretation.main: An intervention that separates latent biological outcomes is not automatically an exact discriminator. It is usable for hard falsification only when the observation process makes the competing observed-outcome supports disjoint.
interpretation.finite_repetition: Increasing finite survey replication from 1 to 8 changes likelihood weights but does not restore exact separation under p<1 or q>0.
interpretation.planner_boundary: Observation uncertainty can turn an otherwise sufficient intervention library into an explicitly insufficient one.
